svg.title: What is tsseg?
svg.desc: A multivariate series is loaded from a labelled dataset (human activity, physiology, motion and surgery, industry and energy, animal behaviour, Earth observation). A method, from any family of change point or state detection methods and behind one API, segments it: change points say where the behaviour changes, states say which regime each point is in (A, B, then A again). Metrics score the result against the truth, and the State Matching Score names each error.
